title: Fuel and Vehicle Standards Legislation Amendment (Reducing Vehicle Pollution) Bill 2022
short_title: Fuel and Vehicle Standards Legislation Amendment (Reducing Vehicle Pollution) Bill 2022

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would tighten fuel quality and light vehicle pollution standards by introducing Euro 6d requirements and linking Australian standards to later European improvements.
It would regulate petrol quality and require compliant light vehicles, with a mechanism to adopt higher European standards within six months of their introduction.
Diesel vehicle requirements would apply from royal assent, while the petrol requirements would operate under separate provisions covering fuel standards and light vehicle standards.
changes: A new petrol fuel standard would be added to the fuel quality framework.
Civil penalties for altering fuel would extend to the new standard.
A new national road vehicle standard would apply alongside Australian Design Rule 79/04.
summary.affected: Petrol fuel and light vehicles powered by petrol or diesel would be covered by the new standards.
